dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with dark outer perimeters and lighter centers are visible. Specifically, a pair of small, well-defined elliptical rings is located center-left, and a larger, more irregular ring structure is visible to the far left with a sharp contrast gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters situated within the dark interstitial fur patches. High-intensity pixel concentrations are localized on the protruding limb and along the brightly lit lower lateral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two central small rings form a near-vertical axis. These, when mapped against the centroid of the large ring to the left and prominent clusters to the lower right, form an irregular geometric constellation characterized by obtuse angles.

other_distinctive_markers: The protruding limb features a series of highly distinct, parallel, high-contrast light-colored longitudinal bands demarcating individual digits.
